name: Russia–Ukraine
value: Grid strikes; aid centre strike (3 Nov)
summary: Russian strikes keep hitting Ukraine's grid; Ukraine hits Ryazan refinery on 5 Nov
state: Zelensky called a Russian bombing of an aid centre in Zaporizhzhia region on 3 Nov one of the war's deadliest attacks (CNN). Russia said on 5 Nov it hit a Ukrainian postal hub and a ship, while Ukraine struck the Ryazan refinery (Al Jazeera). Mass strikes on power plants since 3 Nov have left wide areas short of power as winter starts (Forbes). US-mediated talks are set for 10–11 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice: it advises against all travel to Ukraine.
